description: A multiwriter data structure for Hypercore

sections.title: Usage

methods.name: constructor
methods.signature: const base = new Autobase(store, bootstrap, opts)
methods.description: Instantiate an Autobase.

options.name: ackInterval
options.description: enable auto acking with the interval

options.name: encrypt
options.description: Encrypt the base if unencrypted & no encryptionKey is set

options.name: encrypted
options.description: Expect the base to be encrypted, will throw an error otherwise, defaults to true if encryptionKey is set

options.name: fastForward
options.description: Enable fast forwarding. If passing { key: base.core.key }, they autobase will fastforward to that key first.

options.name: wakeup
options.description: Set a custom wakeup protocol for hinting which writers are active, see `protomux-wakeup` for protocol details

options.name: bigBatches
options.description: Enable big batches. See `base.setBigBatches()` for details.

examples:
{
  open: (store, host) => { ... }, // create the view
  apply: async (nodes, view, host) => { ... }, // handle nodes to update view
  optimistic: false, // Autobase supports optimistic appends
  close: async view => { ... }, // close the view
  valueEncoding, // encoding
  ackInterval: 1000 // enable auto acking with the interval
  encryptionKey: Promise<buffer> | buffer, // Key to encrypt the base
  encrypt: false, // Encrypt the base if unencrypted & no encryptionKey is set
  encrypted: false, // Expect the base to be encrypted, will throw an error otherwise, defaults to true if encryptionKey is set
  fastForward: true, // Enable fast forwarding. If passing { key: base.core.key }, they autobase will fastforward to that key first.
  wakeup: new ProtomuxWakeup(), // Set a custom wakeup protocol for hinting which writers are active, see `protomux-wakeup` for protocol details
  bigBatches: false, // Enable big batches. See `base.setBigBatches()` for details.
}

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Whether the instance is a writer for the autobase.

methods.name: signedLength
methods.description: The index of the system core that has been signed by a quorum of indexers. The system up until this point will not change.

methods.name: length
methods.description: The length of the system core. This is neither the length of the local writer nor the length of the view. The system core tracks the autobase as a whole.

methods.name: hash
methods.returns: Returns the hash of the system core's merkle tree roots.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Creates a replication stream for replicating the autobase. Arguments are the same as [corestores's `.replicate()`](https://github.com/holepunchto/corestore?tab=readme-ov-file#const-stream--storereplicateoptsorstream).

methods.name: heads
methods.description: Gets the current writer heads. A writer head is a node which has no causal dependents, aka it is the latest write. If there is more than one head, there is a causal fork which is pretty common.

methods.name: setBigBatches
methods.description: Set the autobase to enable or disable big batches. Big batches allow autobase to run the `apply` function on more blocks at once at the expense of being slower and less responsive.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Fetch all available data and update the linearizer.

methods.name: ack

params.name: bg
params.description: If `bg` is set to `true`, the ack will not be appended immediately but will set the automatic ack timer to trigger as soon as possible.

methods.description: Manually acknowledge the current state by appending a `null` node that references known head nodes. `null` nodes are ignored by the `apply` handler and only serve as a way to acknowledge the current linearized state. Only indexers can ack.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Append a new entry to the autobase.

options.name: optimistic
options.description: Allow appending on an optimistic autobase while not a writer

methods.name: getLocalCore
methods.description: Generate a local core to be used for an Autobase.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Get user data associated with an autobase `core`. `referrer` is the `.key` of the autobase the `core` is from. `view` is the `name` of the view.

methods.name: isAutobase
methods.returns: Returns whether the core is an autobase core.

methods.name: setUserData

params.name: val
params.description: `value` can be either a string or a buffer.

methods.description: Sets the [User Data](https://github.com/holepunchto/hypercore#user-data) value for the provided `key`. `key` is a string. `value` can be either a string or a buffer.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.returns: Returns the [User Data](https://github.com/holepunchto/hypercore#user-data) value for the provided `key`.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the autobase prevent the next apply from running.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused autobase and will check for an update.

methods.name: key
methods.description: The primary key of the autobase.

methods.name: discoveryKey
methods.description: The discovery key associated with the autobase.

methods.name: isIndexer
methods.description: Whether the instance is an indexer.

methods.name: paused
methods.returns: Returns `true` if the autobase is currently paused, otherwise returns `false`.

methods.name: view
methods.description: The view of the autobase derived from writer inputs. The view is created in the `open` handler and can have any shape. The most common `view` is a [hyperbee](https://github.com/holepunchto/hyperbee).

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when `host.interrupt(reason)` is called in the `apply` handler. See [`host.interrupt(reason)`](#hostinterruptreason) for when interrupts are used.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase view updates after `apply` has finished running.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when an error is triggered while updating the autobase.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase fast forwards to a state already with a quorum. `to` and `from` are the `.signedLength` after and before the fast forward respectively.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase instance is an indexer.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase instance is not an indexer.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase instance is now a writer.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when the autobase instance is no longer a writer.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggered when a warning is triggered.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Load a `Hypercore` by name (passed as `name`). `name` should be passed as a string.

methods.name: addWriter
methods.description: Add a writer with the given `key` to the autobase allowing their local core to append. If `indexer` is `true`, it will be added as an indexer.

methods.name: removeWriter
methods.description: Remove a writer from the autobase. This will throw if the writer cannot be removed.

methods.name: ackWriter
methods.description: Acknowledge a writer even if they haven't been added before. This is most useful for applying `optimistic` blocks from writers that are not currently a writer.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupt the applying of writer blocks optionally giving a `reason`. This will emit an `interrupt` event passing the `reason` to the callback and close the autobase.

methods.name: removeable
methods.returns: Returns whether the writer for the given `key` can be removed.
